description: Deletes a snapshot from a Cognigy.AI project. DESTRUCTIVE & IRREVERSIBLE: The snapshot and all its data will be permanently removed. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. Async operation.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without deleting. Set to false to actually delete. WARNING: This is irreversible!

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check task status (1-10 seconds, default 2)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for deletion (5-300 seconds, default 60)

name: delete_snapshot
